Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
Don't know if this has ever come up before but,

was playing a 3 player game and happened to have a minor boon on...can'T remember who (not important)...one of my prey's ... however when that vampire was bleeding my predator wants to play one of the bouncey cards...

so what is supposed to happen?

Does the action fizzle... or is a bounce not playable... or some other scenario.

thank you kindly

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: He cannot bounce the bleed to a methuselah that the minion cannot bleed.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> He cannot bounce the bleed to a methuselah that the minion cannot bleed.
>
Correct.

LSJ 10/22/2001 referencing a Rules Team Ruling from 1995.

> > If I gave played a minor boon on my grandpredators vampire, can my predator
> > deflect/redirect/misdircet the bleed from that vampire to me, and what
> > happens in that case?
>
> No. One cannot redirect the bleed to an invalid target. [RTR 22-JUN-1995]
>

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answer from Adonai.

Name: Minor Boon
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Boon.
Only usable when a vampire controlled by another Methuselah is going into torpor. Put this card on that vampire to prevent that vampire from going to torpor (combat still ends, if any). This vampire cannot bleed you. Burn this card if this vampire rescues a vampire you control from torpor.
